units.source_text: 本来要是救援之手能够得着的话，那继续装病确实是上上策，事态会朝有利的方向发展。

en.t: Originally, if the hand of rescue could reach him, then continuing to feign illness really was the best possible plan, and events would develop in a favorable direction.

units.source_text: 他之所以拿不定主意，也有这一层考虑。

en.t: This was also one of the considerations behind his inability to make up his mind.

units.source_text: 住在法治的国家里，期待救援是理所当然的事。

en.t: Living in a country governed by law, it was only natural to expect rescue.

units.source_text: 失踪者往往消失在迷雾的那一头，断绝消息，也大多是出于本人的意志。

en.t: Missing people often vanish beyond the far side of the mist, and when all news of them is cut off, it is usually by their own will.

units.source_text: 而且，只要没有犯罪的嫌疑，也就不会当成刑事案件来处理，只能当成民事纠纷处理。

en.t: Moreover, as long as there was no suspicion of a crime, it would not be handled as a criminal case, but only as a civil dispute.

units.source_text: 所以，警察也不能深入去调查。

en.t: Therefore, the police could not investigate it in depth either.

units.source_text: 然而，他可完全是两码事。

en.t: With him, however, it was an entirely different matter.

units.source_text: 像现在这样求救，简直是向死神伸出疯狂的手。

en.t: Calling for help as he was doing now was almost like stretching out a mad hand toward death itself.

units.source_text: 哪用得着直接听到他的声音，看到他的影子，

en.t: There was no need to hear his voice directly or see his shadow,

units.source_text: 只要到他那“失去主人”的屋子里去看看，就一清二楚了：

en.t: for if one merely went and looked inside his room that had lost its master, everything would be perfectly clear:

units.source_text: 尚未读完的书，摊开着书页……

en.t: a book not yet finished, lying open at its pages...

units.source_text: 兜里揣着零钱的上班工作服……

en.t: work clothes for commuting, with small change tucked in the pocket...

units.source_text: 钱虽少，但最近没有取过款的存折……

en.t: a bankbook with little money in it, but with no recent withdrawals...

units.source_text: 尚未整理完毕的、正在干燥的昆虫箱……

en.t: an insect box still unfinished and in the process of drying...

units.source_text: 贴好了邮票，准备寄出去购买新采集瓶的订单……

en.t: an order form, already stamped and ready to be mailed, for the purchase of new collecting bottles...

units.source_text: 一切都表示出他的意志：拒绝就此中断，想要继续活下去。

en.t: Everything expressed his will: his refusal to let it end here, his desire to go on living.

units.source_text: 访问者即使不愿意，也不得不在这屋子里听到他的哀诉。

en.t: Even against their will, any visitor would have no choice but to hear his plaintive appeal in that room.
